animals.name: Cow
animals.sfx_prompt: A single cow mooing deeply in a quiet barn, realistic farm animal recording, clear and natural, 5 seconds
animals.description: The classic lowing moo of a dairy cow.
animals.funFact: Cows have best friends and their heart rate drops when they reunite.

animals.name: Pig
animals.sfx_prompt: A pig oinking and grunting in a pen, realistic farm animal, natural recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: Snuffling oinks and grunts from a contented pig.
animals.funFact: Pigs can recognize their own names and respond like dogs.

animals.name: Sheep
animals.sfx_prompt: A sheep bleating 'baaa' in a grassy field, realistic farm animal recording, clear, 5 seconds
animals.description: The unmistakable bleat of a sheep calling across a pasture.
animals.funFact: Sheep can remember up to 50 individual faces — human or sheep — for years.

animals.name: Goat
animals.sfx_prompt: A goat bleating with a slight warble, realistic farm animal, outdoor recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The nasal, warbling bleat of a goat — sheep-like but with attitude.
animals.funFact: Goats have rectangular pupils that give them nearly 340° vision.

animals.name: Horse
animals.sfx_prompt: A horse neighing and whinnying, realistic natural recording in a stable, clear, 5 seconds
animals.description: A loud, ringing neigh that carries across a stable.
animals.funFact: Horses can read human facial expressions and remember them for months.

animals.name: Donkey
animals.sfx_prompt: A donkey braying loudly, 'hee-haw' call, realistic natural recording outdoors, 5 seconds
animals.description: The iconic hee-haw bray of a donkey.
animals.funFact: A donkey's bray can be heard from over 3 kilometres away.

animals.name: Rooster
animals.sfx_prompt: A rooster crowing 'cock-a-doodle-doo' at dawn, realistic recording, single clear call, 5 seconds
animals.description: The morning crow of a rooster.
animals.funFact: Roosters crow in a specific order determined by their pecking hierarchy.

animals.name: Chicken
animals.sfx_prompt: A hen clucking and cackling in a coop, realistic farm recording, no rooster, 5 seconds
animals.description: The relaxed clucking of a hen in the yard.
animals.funFact: Chickens have distinct alarm calls for aerial vs. ground predators.

animals.name: Duck
animals.sfx_prompt: A mallard duck quacking near water, realistic natural recording, clear quacks, 5 seconds
animals.description: A string of loud, cheerful quacks.
animals.funFact: A duck's quack echoes — scientists just didn't believe it for years.

animals.name: Turkey
animals.sfx_prompt: A wild turkey gobbling loudly, realistic natural recording, clear and distinctive, 5 seconds
animals.description: The rolling gobble of a male turkey.
animals.funFact: Only male turkeys gobble. Females make a soft clucking sound.

animals.name: Dog (barking)
animals.sfx_prompt: A medium-sized dog barking energetically in a backyard, realistic recording, several clear barks, 5 seconds
animals.description: An enthusiastic string of barks — maybe the mailman is here.
animals.funFact: Dogs have over 100 distinct facial expressions.

animals.name: Dog (howling)
animals.sfx_prompt: A dog howling mournfully, long rising and falling tone, realistic recording, no barking, 5 seconds
animals.description: The drawn-out howl of a dog — the wolf is still in there.
animals.funFact: Dogs howl to mark territory and to locate their pack.

animals.name: Cat (meowing)
animals.sfx_prompt: A domestic cat meowing several times, realistic recording, clear and expressive, 5 seconds
animals.description: A cat demanding your attention — or dinner.
animals.funFact: Adult cats only meow at humans, not other cats.

animals.name: Cat (purring)
animals.sfx_prompt: A cat purring deeply and steadily, close microphone recording, no meowing, 5 seconds
animals.description: The steady rumble of a purring cat.
animals.funFact: A cat's purr vibrates at frequencies that help heal bone and tissue.

animals.name: Puppy
animals.sfx_prompt: A small puppy yelping and whimpering, high pitched, realistic recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The high-pitched yips of a young puppy.
animals.funFact: Puppies are born deaf — they can't hear until about three weeks old.

animals.name: Kitten
animals.sfx_prompt: A tiny kitten mewing softly, very high pitched tiny meows, realistic recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: Tiny, high-pitched mews of a kitten.
animals.funFact: Kittens are born blind and with their ears folded down.

animals.name: Parrot
animals.sfx_prompt: A colourful parrot squawking and whistling, tropical bird recording, loud clear calls, 5 seconds
animals.description: The bright squawks and whistles of a parrot.
animals.funFact: African grey parrots can learn vocabularies of over 1,000 words.

animals.name: Hamster
animals.sfx_prompt: A hamster squeaking softly while eating, small rodent sounds, close recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The tiny squeaks and chews of a hamster at dinner.
animals.funFact: Hamsters can store half their body weight in food in their cheek pouches.

animals.name: Lion
animals.sfx_prompt: A lion roaring powerfully in the savanna, low rumbling roar, realistic wildlife recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The ground-shaking roar of a male lion.
animals.funFact: A lion's roar can be heard from up to 8 kilometres away.

animals.name: Tiger
animals.sfx_prompt: A tiger growling and snarling menacingly, low throaty sound, realistic big cat recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The rumbling growl of a tiger on alert.
animals.funFact: Tigers produce infrasound growls below human hearing that can paralyze prey.

animals.name: Elephant
animals.sfx_prompt: An elephant trumpeting loudly, distinctive high-pitched trunk call, realistic wildlife recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The piercing trumpet call of an elephant.
animals.funFact: Elephants communicate through low-frequency rumbles that travel through the ground.

animals.name: Grizzly Bear
animals.sfx_prompt: A grizzly bear growling and roaring aggressively, deep powerful bear roar, realistic wildlife, 5 seconds
animals.description: The deep, guttural roar of a grizzly.
animals.funFact: Grizzlies can run up to 35 mph — faster than any Olympic sprinter.

animals.name: Wolf
animals.sfx_prompt: A gray wolf howling mournfully at night, long drawn-out howl, realistic wildlife recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The haunting howl of a lone wolf.
animals.funFact: Wolves howl in harmonies, each member singing at a different pitch.

animals.name: Fox
animals.sfx_prompt: A red fox screaming with a high pitched eerie wail, realistic nighttime wildlife recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The unsettling, almost-human scream of a red fox.
animals.funFact: Fox screams at night sound so human that people regularly call police.

animals.name: Deer
animals.sfx_prompt: A deer grunting and snorting in the forest, realistic wildlife recording, no other animals, 5 seconds
animals.description: The soft grunts and snorts of a white-tail deer.
animals.funFact: Deer can hear frequencies above 30 kHz — ultrasound to us.

animals.name: Moose
animals.sfx_prompt: A bull moose bellowing during rut season, deep grunting call, realistic wildlife recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The deep bellowing grunt of a bull moose in rut.
animals.funFact: A bull moose bellow can shake windows from a mile away.

animals.name: Coyote
animals.sfx_prompt: Coyotes yipping and howling together as a pack, high pitched yodeling chorus, realistic wildlife, 5 seconds
animals.description: The chaotic, high-pitched chorus of a coyote pack.
animals.funFact: Coyotes can have over 11 distinct vocalizations — the largest repertoire of any canid.

animals.name: Hyena
animals.sfx_prompt: A spotted hyena laughing with its distinctive whooping call, realistic African wildlife recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The eerie cackling laugh of a spotted hyena.
animals.funFact: Hyenas 'laugh' when they're nervous or excited — it's not humor.

animals.name: Chimpanzee
animals.sfx_prompt: A chimpanzee hooting and screeching, pant-hoot call, realistic primate recording in jungle, 5 seconds
animals.description: The rising pant-hoots of a chimpanzee troop.
animals.funFact: Chimpanzees use over 30 distinct gestures — a proto-language.

animals.name: Leopard
animals.sfx_prompt: A leopard snarling and making its rasping sawing call, realistic big cat wildlife recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The rasping saw-like call of a leopard.
animals.funFact: A leopard's call sounds like sawing wood — hence 'sawing' as its technical name.

animals.name: Bald Eagle
animals.sfx_prompt: A bald eagle screeching with its high-pitched chirping call, realistic raptor recording outdoors, 5 seconds
animals.description: The sharp, chittering call of a bald eagle — smaller than you'd think.
animals.funFact: Hollywood always dubs bald eagle calls with red-tailed hawks. The real call is much less impressive.

animals.name: Owl
animals.sfx_prompt: A great horned owl hooting at night, classic 'hoo-hoo' call, realistic nocturnal recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The deep, classic hoo-hoo of a great horned owl.
animals.funFact: Owls can rotate their heads 270 degrees because they can't move their eyes.

animals.name: Crow
animals.sfx_prompt: A crow cawing loudly, several clear caws, realistic natural bird recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The raspy caw of a crow.
animals.funFact: Crows can recognize individual human faces — and hold grudges.

animals.name: Woodpecker
animals.sfx_prompt: A woodpecker drumming rapidly on a tree trunk, rhythmic pecking sound, realistic forest recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The rapid drumroll of a woodpecker on a tree.
animals.funFact: Woodpeckers hit wood at 15 mph, 20 times a second, and their brains are fine.

animals.name: Peacock
animals.sfx_prompt: A peacock screaming its loud piercing call, distinctive 'help help' cry, realistic recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The startling, almost-human scream of a peacock.
animals.funFact: Peacocks 'screaming' are actually males advertising to females.

animals.name: Seagull
animals.sfx_prompt: Seagulls squawking and calling near the ocean, multiple birds, realistic beach recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The shrill squawks of a beach full of seagulls.
animals.funFact: Seagulls can drink seawater — special glands filter out the salt.

animals.name: Pigeon
animals.sfx_prompt: A pigeon cooing softly in a city plaza, soft repetitive coos, realistic urban recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The gentle coo-roo of a city pigeon.
animals.funFact: Pigeons can recognize every letter of the human alphabet.

animals.name: Hummingbird
animals.sfx_prompt: A hummingbird wings humming rapidly, high frequency buzzing of wingbeats, realistic garden recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The rapid hum of hummingbird wings.
animals.funFact: Hummingbird wings beat up to 80 times per second.

animals.name: Dolphin
animals.sfx_prompt: A bottlenose dolphin clicking and whistling underwater, realistic marine mammal recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The squeaky clicks and whistles of a bottlenose dolphin.
animals.funFact: Dolphins give each other unique 'names' — signature whistles.

animals.name: Humpback Whale
animals.sfx_prompt: A humpback whale singing haunting low tones underwater, realistic deep ocean recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The mournful song of a humpback whale.
animals.funFact: Humpback songs can travel over 10,000 miles underwater.

animals.name: Orca
animals.sfx_prompt: An orca killer whale calling with high pitched squeaks and pulses underwater, realistic ocean recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The sharp pulsed calls of an orca pod.
animals.funFact: Each orca pod has its own dialect — a unique set of calls.

animals.name: Seal
animals.sfx_prompt: A harbor seal barking and grunting on a rocky shore, realistic marine mammal recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The guttural barks and grunts of a harbor seal.
animals.funFact: Seals can hold their breath for up to 2 hours.

animals.name: Walrus
animals.sfx_prompt: A walrus making its distinctive bell-like grunting call, realistic arctic marine recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The strange bell-like grunts of a walrus.
animals.funFact: Walruses can sleep while floating vertically in the water.

animals.name: Sea Otter
animals.sfx_prompt: A sea otter squeaking and cooing on the water surface, high pitched mammal squeaks, realistic ocean recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The high-pitched squeaks of a sea otter.
animals.funFact: Sea otters hold hands while they sleep so they don't drift apart.

animals.name: Rattlesnake
animals.sfx_prompt: A rattlesnake rattling its tail in warning, distinctive buzzing rattle, realistic desert recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The warning buzz of a coiled rattlesnake.
animals.funFact: Rattlesnakes grow a new rattle segment every time they shed their skin.

animals.name: Bullfrog
animals.sfx_prompt: An American bullfrog making its deep 'jug-o-rum' croak near a pond, realistic wetland recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The deep 'jug-o-rum' call of a bullfrog.
animals.funFact: A bullfrog's call can be heard from nearly a mile away.

animals.name: Tree Frog
animals.sfx_prompt: Small tree frogs peeping and trilling in the night, high-pitched chorus, realistic forest recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The high, tinkling peeps of a tree frog chorus.
animals.funFact: Some tree frogs can freeze solid in winter and thaw back to life in spring.

animals.name: Alligator
animals.sfx_prompt: An American alligator bellowing low and deep from a swamp, distinctive reptile roar, realistic wetland recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The deep, vibrating bellow of a bull alligator.
animals.funFact: Alligator bellows literally make the water dance above their backs.

animals.name: Gecko
animals.sfx_prompt: A tokay gecko calling loudly, distinctive 'to-kay to-kay' barking chirp, realistic tropical recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The loud 'to-kay' call of a tokay gecko.
animals.funFact: Tokay geckos are named onomatopoeically — they literally say 'to-kay'.

animals.name: Cricket
animals.sfx_prompt: Crickets chirping softly in the warm summer night, steady rhythmic chirps, realistic nature recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The steady chirp of crickets at night.
animals.funFact: You can estimate temperature by counting cricket chirps per minute.

animals.name: Cicada
animals.sfx_prompt: A cicada buzzing loudly in the summer trees, high-pitched droning whine, realistic outdoor recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The piercing drone of cicadas in summer trees.
animals.funFact: Periodical cicadas emerge exactly every 13 or 17 years, right on schedule.

animals.name: Bee
animals.sfx_prompt: Honeybees buzzing around a hive, busy buzzing insect swarm, realistic beekeeping recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The steady buzz of honeybees at work.
animals.funFact: A bee must visit about 2 million flowers to make one pound of honey.

animals.name: Mosquito
animals.sfx_prompt: A mosquito whining with its high-pitched buzz near a microphone, classic annoying hum, realistic recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The infuriating whine of a mosquito next to your ear.
animals.funFact: Only female mosquitoes bite — males just drink nectar.

animals.name: Grasshopper
animals.sfx_prompt: A grasshopper chirping by rubbing its legs, scratchy rhythmic insect sound, realistic meadow recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The scratchy chirp of a grasshopper in dry grass.
animals.funFact: Grasshoppers 'sing' by rubbing a leg across their wing — called stridulation.

animals.name: Wasp
animals.sfx_prompt: A wasp buzzing angrily with a harsher sharper tone than a bee, realistic insect recording, 5 seconds
animals.description: The sharper, meaner buzz of an angry wasp.
animals.funFact: Unlike bees, wasps can sting multiple times — their stinger has no barbs.
